source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 23ης Ιουνίου — «Άγιοι Αριστοκλής ο πρεσβύτερος, Δημητριανός διάκονος και Αθανάσιος αναγνώστης»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 23 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and its own heading for him reads «(; - 302)». The entry names all three members, so it is one folder each, and the corpus already keeps the presbyter Aristocleus of Tamassos from the Romanian calendar on this day. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence. He is not the corpus's `demetrianus-of-tamassos`, the presbyter of Tamassos whose Greek row is already venerated on 27 January; this man is the deacon of the church at Salamis, and the page's narrative calls him Δημήτριος once while its heading and the day's line call him Δημητριανός.
